revision.summary: Auditor decisions applied: R-02 amended (likelihood L4 to L3, split-window evidence left to R-03); all other risks approved unchanged.

changes.change: likelihood 4 → 3 (L4 → L3); split-purchase signal and citations removed from R-02, relying on R-03 for the split-window evidence; scope stays in

risks.title: Payments just below the {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].threshold|gbp}} competition threshold
risks.theme: threshold clustering at the quotation threshold
risks.description: {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].band_count|int}} payments fall in the band just below the threshold at which invitations to quote and a CDP notice are required [rule:CPR-55] [rule:CPR-56], of which {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].band_by_tag.general_procurement.n|int}} are general procurement [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].band_by_tag.general_procurement.n]. An indicator to investigate, not evidence of non-compliance.

likelihood.justification: General procurement payments are present in the band below the threshold [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].band_by_tag.general_procurement.n], but the band count ({{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].band_count|int}}) does not exceed the comparator band just above the threshold ({{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].comparator_count|int}}) [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].comparator_count], so no clustering beyond the comparator is shown.

impact.justification: Value exposed to the indicator (not a loss) is the general procurement value in the band, {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].band_by_tag.general_procurement.gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].band_by_tag.general_procurement.gbp], which sits in the council's Medium financial band [history:IMP-3-FIN].

risks.proposed_focus: For the general procurement payments in the band, check whether quotations were sought as required [rule:CPR-54] and whether related orders for the same requirement together reached the competition threshold [rule:CPR-55].
risks.scope_reason: Low cost to test alongside split purchases (R-03); traces the quotation and competition rules [rule:CPR-54] [rule:CPR-55] [rule:CPR-56]; Contract Letting received Reasonable Assurance [history:AUD-01].

risks.title: Payments just below the {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].threshold|gbp}} Procurement Act threshold for goods and services
risks.theme: threshold clustering at the statutory threshold
risks.description: The band just below the statutory goods and services threshold holds more payments than the band just above it [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].band_count]. Counts are small; an indicator to investigate [rule:CPR-55]. Split-purchase windows at this threshold are rated under R-03, not here.

likelihood.justification: The band below the threshold ({{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].band_count|int}} payments) exceeds the comparator band above it ({{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].comparator_count|int}}) [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].comparator_count], with {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].band_by_tag.general_procurement.n|int}} general procurement payments in the band [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].band_by_tag.general_procurement.n]. The counts are small; the split-window evidence at this threshold is relied on under R-03 so that the two risks are not double-counted.

impact.justification: Value exposed to the clustering indicator (not a loss) is the general procurement value in the band, {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].band_by_tag.general_procurement.gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].band_by_tag.general_procurement.gbp], in the council's Medium financial band [history:IMP-3-FIN]; the split windows' value is rated under R-03.

risks.proposed_focus: For the general procurement payments in the band, establish the total contract value and whether the procurement route and notice met the statutory tier [rule:CPR-55] [rule:CPR-01] and the anti-splitting rule [rule:CPR-11].
risks.scope_reason: Few transactions to test and the statutory tier carries publication duties [rule:CPR-55]; split windows at the same threshold are covered by R-03.

risks.title: Same-supplier payment windows that cross competition thresholds while each payment stays below
risks.description: Within a {{$.tests.split_purchases.parameters.window_days|int}}-day window, payments to one supplier each below a competition threshold combine to cross it in {{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].headline_general_procurement.windows|int}} general procurement windows at the lowest competition threshold [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].headline_general_procurement.windows]. Recurring invoices under one contract also produce this pattern; an indicator to investigate against the anti-splitting rule [rule:CPR-11].

likelihood.justification: General procurement split windows are present at {{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].threshold|gbp}} ({{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].headline_general_procurement.windows|int}} windows) [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].headline_general_procurement.windows] and at {{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].threshold|gbp}} ({{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].headline_general_procurement.windows|int}}) [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].headline_general_procurement.windows]; at the latter a second test points the same way, with payments clustered below the threshold beyond the comparator band [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==173100].band_count]. The clustering evidence is shared with R-02.

impact.justification: Value exposed (not a loss) is the combined value of the general procurement windows at the lowest competition threshold, {{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].headline_general_procurement.gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].headline_general_procurement.gbp], in the council's Critical financial band [history:IMP-5-FIN].

risks.proposed_focus: For the top general procurement windows, establish whether the payments relate to one requirement and, if so, whether the aggregated value was procured by the route its tier requires [rule:CPR-11] [rule:CPR-55] [rule:CPR-56]; separate call-offs under an awarded contract from unrelated orders.
risks.scope_reason: Core test of the anti-splitting rule [rule:CPR-11] with the largest value exposed among the threshold tests [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].headline_general_procurement.gbp].

risks.title: High-value general procurement suppliers with no Contracts Finder notice found
risks.description: {{$.tests.off_contract.statutory_tier.headline_general_procurement_no_notice_found.suppliers|int}} general procurement suppliers with an annualised estimate above the statutory threshold have no matching notice [metric:$.tests.off_contract.statutory_tier.headline_general_procurement_no_notice_found.suppliers]. The notices file is not a contract register [metric:$.contracts.register_present]: no notice found is an indicator to check, never evidence of off-contract spend.

likelihood.justification: General procurement suppliers above the competition threshold with no notice found: {{$.tests.off_contract.headline_general_procurement_no_notice_found.suppliers|int}} [metric:$.tests.off_contract.headline_general_procurement_no_notice_found.suppliers], of which {{$.tests.off_contract.statutory_tier.headline_general_procurement_no_notice_found.suppliers|int}} exceed the statutory threshold [metric:$.tests.off_contract.statutory_tier.headline_general_procurement_no_notice_found.suppliers]. Capped at L3 because no contract register is available, only published notices [metric:$.contracts.register_present].

impact.justification: Value exposed (not a loss) is the annualised estimate for the statutory-tier general procurement suppliers with no notice found, {{$.tests.off_contract.statutory_tier.headline_general_procurement_no_notice_found.annualised_estimate_gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.off_contract.statutory_tier.headline_general_procurement_no_notice_found.annualised_estimate_gbp], in the council's Critical financial band [history:IMP-5-FIN].

risks.proposed_focus: Request the council's contract register and the contract, framework call-off or exemption record for each statutory-tier supplier with no notice found [rule:CPR-55] [rule:CPR-01]; record which are explained by older contracts or Find a Tender notices.
risks.scope_reason: Largest value exposed in the register [metric:$.tests.off_contract.statutory_tier.headline_general_procurement_no_notice_found.annualised_estimate_gbp]; resolving it needs the contract register, a fieldwork request.

risks.title: Repeated equal payments to the same supplier within {{$.tests.duplicates.parameters.max_gap_days|int}} days
risks.description: Payments of the same amount to the same supplier at different times within {{$.tests.duplicates.parameters.max_gap_days|int}} days form {{$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.by_tag.general_procurement.groups|int}} general procurement groups [metric:$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.by_tag.general_procurement.groups]. Instalments and recurring fees also produce this pattern; an indicator to investigate.

likelihood.justification: General procurement groups at different timestamps (the higher-signal tier) are present: {{$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.by_tag.general_procurement.groups|int}} [metric:$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.by_tag.general_procurement.groups]. Accounts Payable received Reasonable Assurance [history:AUD-11], which is coverage, not a repeat finding.

impact.justification: Value exposed (not a loss) is the general procurement value beyond the first payment in each group, {{$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.by_tag.general_procurement.gbp_beyond_first|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.by_tag.general_procurement.gbp_beyond_first], in the council's Medium financial band [history:IMP-3-FIN].

risks.proposed_focus: For the largest general procurement groups, match each payment to a distinct invoice and goods-received record; confirm any duplicate was identified and recovered [history:AUD-11].
risks.scope_reason: Cheap, transaction-level test on a defined population [metric:$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.by_tag.general_procurement.groups]; complements the Accounts Payable audit [history:AUD-11].

risks.title: Spend with suppliers whose every matching notice ended before the spend window
risks.description: {{$.tests.expired_notice_spend.suppliers|int}} suppliers were paid in the window although every matching notice had ended before it [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_spend.suppliers]. A newer contract or approved extension may exist with no notice; an indicator to check against extension approvals [rule:CPR-62].

likelihood.justification: The indicator is present [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_spend.suppliers], but the analytics give no general procurement breakdown for this test, so the L3 condition cannot be shown; the notices file is not a contract register [metric:$.contracts.register_present].

impact.justification: Value exposed (not a loss) is the annualised estimate of spend with these suppliers, {{$.tests.expired_notice_spend.annualised_estimate_gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_spend.annualised_estimate_gbp], in the council's Major financial band [history:IMP-4-FIN].

risks.proposed_focus: For each supplier, obtain the current contract or the extension and its approval by the S151 Officer [rule:CPR-62].
risks.scope_reason: Small, fully listed population [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_spend.suppliers]; only test tracing the extension approval rule [rule:CPR-62].

risks.title: Annualised spend above the published award value for single-supplier notices
risks.description: {{$.tests.spend_vs_award.flagged|int}} of {{$.tests.spend_vs_award.suppliers_compared|int}} suppliers matched to one active notice have an annualised estimate at least {{$.tests.spend_vs_award.parameters.flag_at|ratio}} times the annual award rate [metric:$.tests.spend_vs_award.flagged]. Award values may be estimates or maxima; an indicator to check against variation approvals [rule:CPR-63] [rule:CPR-64].

likelihood.justification: The indicator is present [metric:$.tests.spend_vs_award.flagged], but the analytics give no general procurement breakdown for this test, so the L3 condition cannot be shown.

impact.justification: Value exposed (not a loss) is the flagged suppliers' annualised estimate, {{$.tests.spend_vs_award.flagged_annualised_estimate_gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.spend_vs_award.flagged_annualised_estimate_gbp], in the council's Critical financial band [history:IMP-5-FIN].

risks.proposed_focus: For flagged suppliers, compare actual spend to the contract value and obtain any variation and its approval [rule:CPR-63] [rule:CPR-64].
risks.scope_reason: Small, fully listed population [metric:$.tests.spend_vs_award.flagged]; only test tracing the variation approval rules [rule:CPR-63] [rule:CPR-64].

risks.title: Recurring care and education placement payments crossing competition thresholds
risks.description: Placement payments form {{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].by_tag.care_or_education_placement.windows|int}} same-supplier windows crossing the lowest competition threshold [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].by_tag.care_or_education_placement.windows]. Placements may be awarded without competition if reasons are recorded [rule:CPR-65]; periodic fees legitimately recur. An indicator to check the exemption records.

likelihood.justification: Indicators are present only on the placement population [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].by_tag.care_or_education_placement.windows] [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==25000].band_by_tag.care_or_education_placement.n], which may be exempt from competition [rule:CPR-65], so the rating stays at L2. Purchase of residential and nursing care received Reasonable Assurance [history:AUD-14] (coverage, not a repeat finding).

impact.justification: The rule at stake is recording the reasons for the choice of provider on case notes [rule:CPR-65]; a missing record is a compliance gap with low possibility of legal challenge or regulatory interest [history:IMP-2-CMP].

risks.proposed_focus: For a sample of placement suppliers with windows crossing the threshold, confirm the reasons for the choice of provider are recorded on case notes [rule:CPR-65].
risks.scope_reason: Exempt population [rule:CPR-65] recently covered by a Reasonable Assurance audit [history:AUD-14]; recommended for a later plan unless the auditor wishes to include it.

risks.title: Payments clustered just below the {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==1000].threshold|gbp}} quotation threshold
risks.theme: threshold clustering at the single-quote threshold
risks.description: The band just below the single-quote threshold holds more payments than the band just above it [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==1000].band_count], including general procurement payments. An indicator to investigate against the quotation rule [rule:CPR-54].

likelihood.justification: The band ({{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==1000].band_count|int}}) exceeds the comparator ({{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==1000].comparator_count|int}}) [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==1000].comparator_count], with {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==1000].band_by_tag.general_procurement.n|int}} general procurement payments in the band [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==1000].band_by_tag.general_procurement.n]; most of the band is placement spend.

impact.justification: Value exposed (not a loss) is the general procurement value in the band, {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==1000].band_by_tag.general_procurement.gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==1000].band_by_tag.general_procurement.gbp], in the council's Minor financial band [history:IMP-2-FIN].

risks.proposed_focus: For a sample of general procurement payments in the band, confirm a quote was obtained [rule:CPR-54].
risks.scope_reason: Low value exposed [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==1000].band_by_tag.general_procurement.gbp] and the rule asks only for one quote [rule:CPR-54]; traced here so the rule is covered.

risks.title: Waivers, exceptions and award approvals not testable from the spend data
risks.description: The rules require named approvals for exceptions to competition and for awards by value tier [rule:CPR-18] [rule:CPR-20] [rule:CPR-50]; the spend data holds no approval or contract-type field, so these controls are tested by walkthrough and sample, not analytics.

likelihood.justification: No data indicator: approvals are not in the spend data and the contract-type field needed for the statutory tiers is absent; only the rules [rule:CPR-20] and coverage by the Contract Letting audit (Reasonable Assurance) [history:AUD-01] are cited.

impact.justification: An unapproved exception or award above the statutory threshold carries a reasonable possibility of successful legal challenge [history:IMP-3-CMP] [rule:CPR-22].

risks.proposed_focus: Walk through the waiver and exception log and award approvals; test approvals for the high-value suppliers drawn in R-04 and R-03 against the approval tiers [rule:CPR-21] [rule:CPR-22] [rule:CPR-23] [rule:CPR-50] [rule:CPR-51] [rule:CPR-52] [rule:CPR-53].
risks.scope_reason: Approver rules cannot be tested from the data and need control testing [rule:CPR-20]; no clustering or split windows at the upper value tier [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[?threshold==500000].band_count], so no separate risk there.

risks.title: No published tracker of agreed audit actions to confirm prior procurement findings are closed
risks.description: The committee papers publish no action tracker, due dates or statuses [history:GAP-01], so the status of actions from the Contract Letting and Accounts Payable audits cannot be confirmed [history:AUD-01] [history:AUD-11].

likelihood.justification: Only a gap is cited, with no data indicator [history:GAP-01].

impact.justification: Unconfirmed closure of agreed actions is a governance gap with low possibility of regulatory interest [history:IMP-2-CMP].

risks.proposed_focus: Request the action tracker for the Contract Letting and Accounts Payable audits and confirm the status of each agreed action [history:AUD-01] [history:AUD-11].
risks.scope_reason: A one-line request on the PBC list closes the gap [history:GAP-01].
